features.quote: cap on turns and wall-clock time
Terminate when: max turns reached; wall-clock limit reached; model declares inability repeatedly; task is solved; judge detects meltdown threshold; environment enters unrecoverable loop
After the main task, run a separate probe only on some episodes.
